import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#3498db'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=bmi, alpha=0.6, s=50, c=bmi_colors.get(bmi, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax2.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# Plot 3: Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Handle NaN in Sleep Disorder
df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_markers = {'None': 'o', 'Insomnia': 's', 'Sleep Apnea': '^'}
disorder_colors = {'None': '#3498db', 'Insomnia': '#e74c3c', 'Sleep Apnea': '#9b59b6'}

for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder Filled'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] == disorder]
    ax3.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'],
                label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50, 
                marker=disorder_markers.get(disorder, 'o'),
                c=disorder_colors.get(disorder, '#95a5a6'))
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Stress Level vs Physical Activity by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
gender_colors = {'Male': '#3498db', 'Female': '#e91e63'}
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    sns.kdeplot(data=subset['Sleep Duration'], ax=ax4, label=gender, 
                fill=True, alpha=0.4, color=gender_colors.get(gender, '#95a5a6'))
ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Gender')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
